count_semantics: Source rows and distinct vendor labels are not deduplicated worldwide camera identities. Zero rows is a retrieval/evidence gap.

agfaphoto.scope: Historical Agfa ePhoto vs licensed AgfaPhoto DC/Optima/Realishot, waterproof, vlogging and children cameras.
agfaphoto.completeness_finding: The requested category URL resolves to a home-page canonical. Its six visible model names are a sample, not the full shop. Agfa ePhoto interoperability belongs to a different era and is kept separately labeled.
agfaphoto.project_finding: No primary camera modification retained. Do not infer shared firmware from the licensed mark.

akaso.scope: BRAVE, V50, EK7000 and AKASO 360; Lite/Pro/LE/revision suffixes remain distinct.
akaso.completeness_finding: Action marketing page covers five labels; the shop collection could not be retrieved. Older EK/V50/BRAVE variants and SKU-specific boards remain unenumerated.
akaso.project_finding: BRAVE8 Ambarella unpack/repack; V50 Pro recovery is explicitly excluded by the retained iCatch project.

arri.scope: ALEXA 265, 35/Xtreme/Live, LF/Mini LF, AMIRA; legacy ALEXA/SXT and digital D-20/D-21 history.
arri.completeness_finding: Current and legacy landing pages extracted. ALEXA Classic, Plus, Studio, XT, SXT subvariants, 65 rental bodies, and D-20/D-21 need linked historical records; three legacy landing cards are not a full history.
arri.project_finding: Official CAP/metadata/partner interfaces; no qualified replacement firmware.

benq.scope: Legacy DC/C/E/G/LM camera families; exclude monitors, projectors and conference peripherals.
benq.completeness_finding: The legacy manufacturer camera-download route was unavailable. One gPhoto camera row is an interoperability lead, not a brand roster.
benq.project_finding: No primary feature modification retained; monitor firmware and DV01K conference-camera results were excluded from compact-camera claims.

blackmagic-design.scope: URSA Cine/Immersive, PYXIS, URSA Mini/Pro, Pocket/Cinema, Studio/Micro Studio and Broadcast; historical Cinema/Production/Micro Cinema bodies.
blackmagic-design.completeness_finding: Current products page yields 16 camera/family headings after excluding accessories and the phone app. URSA Cine sensor/mount variants and discontinued bodies require product/support detail pages; the list is not every SKU.
blackmagic-design.project_finding: Official REST/SDI/Bluetooth/control protocols. Media decoding and host capture cards do not establish firmware modification.

canon.scope: EOS DSLR/M/R, PowerShot/IXUS/IXY, Cinema EOS, digital video and HD camcorders.
canon.completeness_finding: 466 museum product entries extracted from digital categories, excluding film, analog still-video and 8mm tape. Regional aliases may share entries. Current store retrieval failed; museum coverage is not a verified current worldwide offering list.
canon.project_finding: CHDK and Magic Lantern are separate compatibility paths; modern ML platform directories are research evidence, not released ports. The Ritual remains a separate 5D target.

casio.scope: QV and EXILIM EX families, TR/TR M/FR/GZE, plus WQV camera watches.
casio.completeness_finding: Official regional manual search loads but warns some products are absent and does not render a complete model list. Thirteen gPhoto and 53 LibRaw labels are independent subsets, not the full QV/EX catalog.
casio.project_finding: New retained WQV protocol and WQV Blink interoperability projects; RAW-menu decoder labels alone do not qualify a firmware procedure.

contax-kyocera.scope: CONTAX N Digital, TVS Digital, i4R, U4R; Kyocera Finecam/Samurai digital models.
contax-kyocera.completeness_finding: Vendor optical support page survives as a service notice, not a model archive. LibRaw identifies N Digital only; the other bodies and regional Finecam variants need archived manuals.
contax-kyocera.project_finding: No digital-camera firmware modification retained; Contax T2/G/167MT film repairs are excluded.

digital-bolex.scope: D16 and monochrome D16M; storage/mount variants must not be assumed new firmware targets.
digital-bolex.completeness_finding: LibRaw enumerates both digital bodies. Original manual/spec links survive in search, while home capture returned a short shell. Full configuration and firmware history not reconstructed.
digital-bolex.project_finding: Original update manual is maintenance evidence. Rebuild/replica projects require their own primary provenance; a new Raspberry Pi camera is not a D16 firmware port.

dji.scope: Osmo/Pocket, Action, 360/Nano and Ronin 4D handheld capture; retain original Osmo Pro/RAW.
dji.completeness_finding: All 15 retained handheld headings exclude phone-only gimbals/mics. Drone-integrated cameras and Zenmuse payloads are a separate unenumerated product track, not silently covered.
dji.project_finding: OpenPocketCine is external monitoring/control, bounded by its model/platform matrix. No generic DJI firmware modification is claimed.

epson.scope: R-D1/R-D1s/R-D1xG, L compact cameras and CP/PhotoPC heritage.
epson.completeness_finding: Japanese vendor index yields 20 download identities. CP regional names and international PhotoPC aliases need reconciliation; R-D1xG is the vendor grip-kit identity.
epson.project_finding: R-D1 vendor 2.0 upgrade explicitly disallows downgrade. No third-party feature patch qualified.

fujifilm.scope: Full X-series family audit retained; GFX and FinePix appear only as supplementary raw/transfer subsets.
fujifilm.completeness_finding: X-series coverage is source-bound to 53 identities in family-coverage.json, not all Fuji products. FinePix and GFX worldwide/history completeness remains outside that denominator.
fujifilm.project_finding: Fujihack/FujiMod, libfuji/fujicli and Furble evidence remain model/firmware-specific.

general-imaging.scope: GE A/C/E/G/J/PJ/Q/Smart/X compact/bridge families and regional aliases.
general-imaging.completeness_finding: Former general-imaging.com now serves unrelated magazine content and is rejected as a camera source. No authoritative complete roster recovered; neither a zero row count nor the Kodak license history resolves this gap.
general-imaging.project_finding: No primary modification project qualified; obtain authored manuals and original OEM/revision evidence before drawing compatibility conclusions.

gopro.scope: MISSION, HERO Black/Silver/White/Session/Mini/Bones, MAX/MAX2 and Fusion heritage.
gopro.completeness_finding: Shop/compare labels and Labs release list retained. Bare HERO is ambiguous across years; editions/creator kits are not separate bodies. Early Digital HERO and all historical Silver/White/Session variants are not fully reconciled.
gopro.project_finding: Labs exact model releases plus per-feature matrix; Open GoPro official control. Not every current body has a Labs release (e.g. do not infer LIT HERO).

hasselblad.scope: X1D/X2D, 907X/CFV, H digital bodies/backs and older CF/CFV; Lunar/Stellar/HV require separate legacy identities.
hasselblad.completeness_finding: X/V/H vendor pages and 39 LibRaw labels retained. H6X is a host body rather than a standalone digital capture device. Older H sensor/multishot/CF/back combinations, rebadges and all editions remain a roster gap.
hasselblad.project_finding: Keep X2D/907 first-generation extensions separate from X2D II; no support inferred for X1D/H/older CFV.

hp.scope: Photosmart numbered, C/M/R/E families and older camera interfaces.
hp.completeness_finding: Current HP support shell does not enumerate the discontinued camera range. Fifty-three gPhoto rows retain exact interoperability names; printers and scanners excluded.
hp.project_finding: No primary Photosmart firmware extension qualified; transfer protocol source is useful independently of feature patches.

insta360.scope: X/ONE/ONE X/ONE R/RS, GO, Ace, Luna, Pro/Titan; Link/Connect webcam track kept distinct.
insta360.completeness_finding: Product navigation and download data extracted; hot downloads are not the full catalog. Original ONE/RS lens-module bundles, EVO/Nano/Air and region-specific retired models need support archive closure. Phone-only Flow and microphones excluded.
insta360.project_finding: ONE R positive/X3 negative live-stream report, Luna Ultra specific firmware and Link webcam research are separate targets; official SDK capabilities also need model checks.

jvc.scope: Pro GY/KY cameras, consumer Everio/GZ/GC/GR digital models; exclude analog-only camcorders.
jvc.completeness_finding: Five Singapore professional camcorder identities extracted. Official API found via search has family wildcards, not exact product identities; direct API-page capture was unavailable. Current and legacy consumer/pro regional catalogs have not been reconciled.
jvc.project_finding: Official Camcorder Web API has a model-family/firmware/API-version matrix. No replacement firmware qualified.

kinefinity.scope: VISTA, MAVO Edge/mark2 and earlier MAVO/TERRA/KineMAX/KineMINI/KineRAW digital cinema generations.
kinefinity.completeness_finding: Four current family cards and seven historical firmware labels extracted. mark2 S35/LF, slash-bundled MAVO LF/MAVO and VISTA configuration details still need detail pages. Some migrated old KineOS cards carry newer Edge model tags; do not treat those tags as validated backward compatibility.
kinefinity.project_finding: Vendor KineOS updates are maintenance, not evidence of unsigned firmware or third-party features.

kodak.scope: DCS/ProBack, EasyShare/DC/Advantix digital heritage, PIXPRO, Charmera and licensed instant/hybrid cameras.
kodak.completeness_finding: PIXPRO support yields 44 current/previous labels plus 100 gPhoto and 42 LibRaw rows. Serial-number firmware branches matter. No single Kodak page covers every historical/licensee line; Charmera and other licensed mini/hybrid bodies need separate catalogs.
kodak.project_finding: Kodak DCS/ProBack tools and Charmera Generalplus project are unrelated firmware families; raw decoding is separate.

konica-minolta.scope: Konica KD/Q/MG/Revio; Minolta RD/DiMAGE and Dynax/Maxxum/Alpha DSLR regional aliases.
konica-minolta.completeness_finding: Vendor support root unavailable. Fourteen gPhoto rows and 17 LibRaw names cover subsets; cameras across both brands and premerger naming need authored archive records. Modern licensed Minolta products are another unresolved catalog.
konica-minolta.project_finding: LibRaw source contains DiMAGE Z2 RAW-identification logic; this is decoding evidence, not a recovered camera-side enablement/recovery procedure. Sony firmware compatibility is not implied.

leica.scope: Digital M, Q, SL, S/S2, CL/T/TL, X, D/C/V-Lux, Digilux, SOFORT 2 and Digital-Modul-R heritage.
leica.completeness_finding: Fourteen current digital/hybrid navigation labels plus legacy LibRaw subset retained. Analog M6/MP/M-A and original analog SOFORT excluded. Legacy firmware/download taxonomy is not a complete model census or full special-edition roster.
leica.project_finding: LeicaHacks M8/M9/M240 scope stays separate from M10/M11/Q/SL; official FOTOS/control is another mechanism.

lytro.scope: First-generation light-field cameras and ILLUM; Cinema/Immerge prototypes are a separate professional history.
lytro.completeness_finding: Original-camera project and mirrored vendor ILLUM release notes establish distinct tracks. Storage/color editions and professional prototypes were not exhaustively enumerated.
lytro.project_finding: lytro_unlock original camera and preserved Lytro Power Tools/ILLUM host tooling must not be treated as one firmware target.

nikon.scope: Z mirrorless, ZR cinema, F digital SLR, Nikon 1, COOLPIX and KeyMission.
nikon.completeness_finding: 192 names extracted from five camera categories in the official selector XML, excluding lenses/accessories. The separately inspected archive currently lists software, not additional cameras; older COOLPIX/E-series and regional names must be reconciled before declaring all-time completeness.
nikon.project_finding: NikonHacker DSLR patch tools and Wonder Lantern Z30 are distinct. Legacy COOLPIX DIAG RAW decoding does not establish modern Z compatibility.

olympus-om-system.scope: OM/OM-D/PEN, Four Thirds E, TG/Tracker; older C/CAMEDIA/FE/SP/mju/STYLUS/XZ/SZ/VH/VR.
olympus-om-system.completeness_finding: Body/manual and firmware tables merged as source rows, with no-update E-PL10 and TG-6 retained. Compact and early Four Thirds archive completeness remains unresolved; firmware availability is not the model denominator.
olympus-om-system.project_finding: fishcu/firmware analysis and per-model Olympus firmware database are documentary routes. PEN-F/OM-1 offsets or recovery cannot be generalized.

panasonic.scope: LUMIX S/G/GH/GX/GF/GM, earlier Four Thirds L1/L10, fixed-lens TZ/ZS/LX/FZ/FT/TS/FX/FH/FS/FP/LS/LZ/SZ/CM and digital camcorders.
panasonic.completeness_finding: 118 firmware source rows preserve regional alias bundles and exceptions. Models without updates, legacy Four Thirds and HC/AG/AU/V broadcast/camcorder lines are not a complete worldwide census. The initial /fts/index.html was an empty redirect stub, not a roster.
panasonic.project_finding: PTool GH1/GH2, GH4 language research, LUMIX Remote tested S5 and official SDK are separate compatibility paths.

pentax.scope: K/*ist DSLRs, 645 digital/IR, Q/K-01 mirrorless, Optio/MX/XG/X and WG/action families.
pentax.completeness_finding: Firmware plus current product and Optio/WG archive records retained. Regional K-m/K2000 labels and slash-bundled K-5II/IIs are not silently deduplicated. Earliest compact/Optio bodies and all WG/GPS/region variants need archive reconciliation. Ricoh business/GR rows are kept in Ricoh.
pentax.project_finding: pkTriggerCord model/bugs matrix and historical Pentax Hack accessibility limit retained; GR firmware cannot be applied to K/Q/645 bodies.

phase-one-mamiya.scope: Photographic 645AF/DF/DF+/XF/XT/XC bodies, IQ/P/H/scanning backs, Mamiya ZD/M/DM and Leaf digital backs.
phase-one-mamiya.completeness_finding: Official serial catalog captures photographic bodies/backs, with LibRaw subsets. Regional back mounts and body/back combinations are not one firmware target. Leaf Credo/Aptus/Valeo and early scanning back model/variant closure remains incomplete. Aerial/industrial systems excluded from this photographic ledger.
phase-one-mamiya.project_finding: Official SDK, Kodak body/back protocol work and newly retained PhaseOne-IIQ-Tools for IIQ/calibration/remapping. Its author explicitly says firmware exploration is not deep yet.

polaroid.scope: PDC/PhotoMAX/i/t/x/other licensed digital compacts; Snap/Snap Touch/Pop/Z digital-hybrid devices.
polaroid.completeness_finding: Current polaroid.com is dominated by analog instant cameras (including Mod), not an exhaustive licensed digital archive. Six gPhoto entries and x530 LibRaw support are subsets. No complete current/historical licensee roster recovered.
polaroid.project_finding: SX-70 controller replacement is film-camera work and excluded from digital hacking claims. No primary digital-camera extension qualified.

red.scope: Current V-RAPTOR and KOMODO-X variants; legacy RED ONE, EPIC/SCARLET/WEAPON/DSMC2/RANGER/KOMODO/DSMC3 sensor and mount variants.
red.completeness_finding: Current camera category explicitly lists eight entries, all captured. Its product-option counts describe kits, not extra body models. Legacy bodies and sensor generations require support archives before historical completeness can be claimed.
red.project_finding: RCP/RCP2 official SDK/control routes, not replacement firmware. Generation, transport and firmware-specific commands must match.

ricoh.scope: Full digital GR family audit retained; Caplio/R/CX/GX/GXR, WG/G business and THETA are separate expansion tracks.
ricoh.completeness_finding: GR source-bound coverage is 23 identities in family-coverage.json. Supplementary Ricoh firmware/gPhoto/LibRaw lists do not establish completeness of the other families. GXR modules and THETA require model-level records.
ricoh.project_finding: GR runtime, patcher and protocol project inventory remain per model/firmware; no GR IV patch compatibility inferred for other Ricoh cameras.

rollei.scope: Legacy compact/digital back models plus licensed Compactline/Powerflex/Sportsline/Actioncam products.
rollei.completeness_finding: Current catalog retrieval failed; search located /collections/kameras but not a full extract. Two gPhoto rows and d530flex raw support are narrow subsets. Include db20p digital back via Phase One source; no all-model claim.
rollei.project_finding: Rollei frame hacks, lens firmware and film-camera repair excluded. A DR5100/Caplio-GX forum lead is unverified; no retained camera modification implementation.

samsung.scope: NX/NX mini/GX DSLRs; EX/WB/ST/PL/ES/Digimax/i/L/NV compact families; separate Gear 360 camera track.
samsung.completeness_finding: Manufacturer downloads shell does not yield the retired camera roster. Six gPhoto and 44 LibRaw labels do not cover every digital compact or regional NX/GX variant.
samsung.project_finding: NX generation architecture differences, NX1/NX500 mods and GX-10 pkTriggerCord route; no Linux assumption for every Samsung camera.

sanyo.scope: Xacti VPC/DMX hybrid video/still and earlier DSC compact families.
sanyo.completeness_finding: Former Panasonic/Sanyo page unavailable. Eight gPhoto names are only an interoperability subset; VPC/DMX regional aliases and extensive camcorder generations remain unenumerated.
sanyo.project_finding: Service-manual update leads are not third-party feature modification/recovery evidence.

sigma.scope: BF, fp/fp L, sd Quattro/H, SD DSLR, DP/dp Merrill/Quattro and prior compact revisions.
sigma.completeness_finding: Twenty-two camera-only firmware rows extracted, excluding all lens/accessory rows. LibRaw adds SD10/DP1s leads absent from that table. No-update and regional/kit variants need reconciliation.
sigma.project_finding: fpSup targets fp 5.02; fp L/BF/SD/DP addresses and functions are not covered by that result.

sjcam.scope: SJ/C action and wearable cameras, M/ZV compacts; exact board and display/sensor revisions retained.
sjcam.completeness_finding: Catalog/navigation labels extracted with NEW badges removed. Home S1 and accessory/use-case links excluded. Original SJ4000/5000/6/7/8/9/10 generations and hardware revisions need historical support closure.
sjcam.project_finding: Lelouch SJ4000 Air Allwinner V3 and independent SJ4000 remote CLI are separate board/protocol evidence; retail names do not prove chipset equivalence.

sony.scope: Alpha A/E/NEX, Cyber-shot/DSC/RX/QX, digital Mavica, Handycam, Action Cam and FX/Cinema generations.
sony.completeness_finding: Official support shows 643 digital-category entries but includes lenses and exposes only initial results; video support is separately paginated. Direct captures failed. The 158 gPhoto and 115 LibRaw rows are subsets, not 643 cameras or a full Sony census.
sony.project_finding: PMCA updater/app/service modes and OpenMemories vary by architecture. Modern Alpha/FX claims require their own primary port and recovery evidence.

toshiba.scope: PDR digital still camera and CAMILEO digital camcorder families.
toshiba.completeness_finding: Five gPhoto names cannot enumerate the legacy PDR/CAMILEO range. No complete manufacturer camera roster recovered; historical storage-capacity updates are maintenance leads.
toshiba.project_finding: No retained primary feature modification; firmware-update availability alone is not unsigned-code acceptance.

vivitar.scope: ViviCam, digital camcorders/action cameras, PopSnap and mini/keychain licensee hardware.
vivitar.completeness_finding: Manufacturer retrieval failed. Seven gPhoto labels are old transfer entries; current licensed digital models and firmware/board revisions remain a roster gap.
vivitar.project_finding: No primary modification qualified. Search claims of public firmware/schematics without a reachable original repository were not accepted; a teardown video would need separate media verification.

xiaomi-yi.scope: Yi Sport, Lite/Discovery, 4K/4K+, M1 mirrorless and Xiaomi/Mijia action hardware as distinct OEM tracks.
xiaomi-yi.completeness_finding: Current YI homepage promotes home/security systems and is not an action-camera archive. LibRaw identifies YI 4K and M1 only. Older action/4K+ and Xiaomi/Mijia regional/hardware revisions need separate manuals.
xiaomi-yi.project_finding: First-generation autoexec and 4K 1.10.9 projects remain separate. Security camera Yi-Hack does not establish action-camera compatibility.

yashica.scope: Modern Y35/digiFilm, City, FX-D, Tank, Crew, Y16, keychain and Journey camcorder; legacy compact families separate.
yashica.completeness_finding: Homepage captures seven visible digital product labels including preorders, not the complete store/archive. Color SKUs and in-body film looks do not establish common firmware.
yashica.project_finding: No primary digital feature-modification workflow retained. Analog Yashica-to-Raspberry Pi conversions are a different hardware project.

z-cam.scope: E1, E2/C/M4/S6/F6/F8 and Pro/Mark II/global-shutter variants; S/VR and PTZ families separately identified.
z-cam.completeness_finding: Current professional page/nav retains eight model labels, including four Mark II sensor bodies sharing a family route. Old E1/E2/VR and PTZ catalogs are not exhaustively reconciled.
z-cam.project_finding: Official E2 API and independent E2 firmware research; E1/E2 generations and firmware/SoC differences remain material.

zeiss.scope: ZX1 digital still camera; separate camera modules/security/industrial optics excluded.
zeiss.completeness_finding: Former vendor ZX1 URL redirects to a generic photography page with no ZX1 record and is rejected as model evidence. LibRaw identifies ZX1, but no complete vendor archive or current OTA/recovery availability was verified.
zeiss.project_finding: No primary ZX1 jailbreak qualified. Android architecture or Lightroom integration does not establish root access.
